description: ARM storage account whose network rules default to Allow
note: CIS Azure 4.7 and 4.8. defaultAction Allow makes every firewall rule on the account decoration. CORRECTED after the confirming run 2026-09-22: CKV_AZURE_36 was expected for the trusted-services half and does not fire -- checkov only asks about the bypass list once defaultAction is Deny, which is reasonable, since with Allow there is nothing to bypass. Trivy's AZU-0010 does raise it here and is labelled instead.
